nodes.speaker: Distant voice
nodes.text: <shake>HEY! YOU, BY THE TREES!</shake>

nodes.speaker: Distant voice
nodes.text: Yes, you! Orientation started ages ago. Over here, quickly!

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: ...Orientation? Does the afterlife have that?

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Well, I don't have any better ideas. Probably best to do what they say. Could be an isekai, after all.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: <wave>There</wave> you are! Do you have any idea what time it is?

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: I'm Professor Kepler, and you've already missed orientation. On your very first day, no less.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Missed it? If I'm dead, I don't think there should be any rush.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: No time for excuses. Your letter of admission, please. Quickly.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: Uhhhhhhhh.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: No letter? Then I'm afraid you're trespassing.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: {player}. There, you're on the list. Enjoy the next few years!

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: Now in you get, quickly! Head straight down and you'll find what's left of orientation.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: From one school straight into another. If you're taking me to a new world, at least make it a cool one.

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: ...A letter. In my hands. Blown here by the wind, from some poor stranger. Sure. Why not.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: Well? Why didn't you show me that earlier? Let's have a look.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: ...The ink's run. I can't read a word of this.

nodes.speaker: Prof. Kepler
nodes.text: Your name, quickly, so I can mark you down.

nodes.speaker: Late Student
nodes.text: I HAD a letter. It was right here. In my hand.

nodes.speaker: Late Student
nodes.text: And then the wind just... took it. Straight to some stranger. Who does that happen to?

nodes.speaker: {player}
nodes.text: ...I should probably not mention that.
